name: Hochstein
kurzbeschreibung: The **Hochstein** offers one of the most stunning views over the **Lienzer Becken** and the **Isel** and can be reached via a modern cable car.
beschreibung: Hochstein – The **Hochstein** offers one of the most breathtaking views across the entire Alpine region. From its summit, you’ll enjoy stunning vistas over the **Lienzer Becken** and the **Isel** River, accessible via a modern cable car. A 360-degree panorama unfolds from the peak, with clear views stretching all the way to the glaciers of the **Hohe Tauern** on crisp days. The convenient mountain railway effortlessly transports visitors to the top, where panoramic terraces and a mountain restaurant await for relaxation. Just a few kilometers from **Lienz**, the **Hochstein** invites you to explore untouched nature. The location also provides a magnificent panoramic view of the surrounding mountain ranges. A visit to the **Hochstein** is worthwhile year-round and is sure to leave a lasting impression.
